visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a white puffer jacket over a red patterned shirt, sits at a mahjong table in a room with dramatic red and blue lighting. She looks focused, her hands expertly handling blue-backed mahjong tiles on the green felt surface. (2) Another young woman with wavy brown hair in a tan hoodie is shown laughing mockingly. Her eyes briefly glow with a supernatural red effect. The setting is indoor, possibly a studio or dedicated game room, filled with mahjong tables and players in the background. (3) The camera uses fast cuts to show a young man with silver-blonde hair and facial makeup simulating wounds and bruises. He wears a dark suit jacket and looks intensely at the game. Mahjong tiles are shuffled aggressively on the table, creating a sense of chaotic energy. (4) The first woman closes her eyes, then reopens them to reveal glowing blue irises. Visual effects like smoke and ethereal light begin to rise from her hand of mahjong tiles. She flips the tiles over to reveal a winning combination, her expression changing from concentration to a fierce, supernatural determination. (5) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban street at night. The man with the wounded face stands under a shop awning, lighting a cigarette with a weary expression. The main woman, now wearing a white knit beanie, stands beside him, looking off into the distance as if lost in thought.

The BGM remains tense and rhythmic. (3) An aggressive female voice mocks the others, her laughter echoed with digital reverb. The sound of tiles being shuffled creates a dense, percussive layer beneath the dialogue. (4) The audio transitions into a calm, melodic piano segment. A soft, breathy female narration takes over, speaking in a reflective tone. The background environmental noise is minimal, suggesting a quiet outdoor space. (5) The final phase features upbeat pop-style BGM with high-tempo percussion. Multiple voices are heard laughing and chatting in a messy, celebratory mix, marking the shift to behind-the-scenes content.
